S

vocabulary.definition: the practice of training people to obey rules or a code of behavior, using punishment to correct disobedience
vocabulary.example: She attributed her success to her discipline in following a strict daily routine.

vocabulary.definition: the ability to control one's impulses and make oneself do things that should be done
vocabulary.example: Despite the temptation to eat the cake, she used her willpower to stick to her diet.

vocabulary.definition: feeling or expressing distress and annoyance resulting from an inability to change or achieve something
vocabulary.example: He felt frustrated with the slow progress of his project.

vocabulary.definition: a state in which a person functions without being conscious of their actions
vocabulary.example: After years of driving the same route, she could do it on autopilot without thinking.

vocabulary.definition: causing a feeling of enjoyment or satisfaction
vocabulary.example: She found gardening to be a pleasurable activity that helped her relax.

vocabulary.definition: a person or animal with whom one spends a lot of time or with whom one travels
vocabulary.example: Her dog was her loyal companion on all her outdoor adventures.
